provenance.encodes: Indigo Book T6 (Required Abbreviations for Treaty Sources): <treaty name>, <parties>, <date>, <vol> U.N.T.S. <page>

positive.text: See Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties, May 23, 1969, 1155 U.N.T.S. 331.
The court relied on 999 U.N.T.S. 171 in reaching its holding.
International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights, Dec. 16, 1966, 999 U.N.T.S. 171.

note: The signing date before the volume is part of the citation (Indigo T6 form), so it is spanned when present. Only a page range is taken as a pin: a single number after the comma is usually the volume of a parallel cite (1577 U.N.T.S. 3, 28 I.L.M. 1448).
